proof.statement:
∀ (sample : Fin 2) (x : Fin 64 → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin 64),
      ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.inputValue
            (if sample = 0 then ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.inputLo0Z
            else ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.inputLo7Z)
            i ≤
          x i ∧
        x i ≤
          ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.inputValue
            (if sample = 0 then ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.inputHi0Z
            else ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.inputHi7Z)
            i) →
    ∀ (j : Fin 10),
      ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.certValue
            (if sample = 0 then ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.certLo0Z
            else ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.certLo7Z)
            j ≤
          ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.eval x j ∧
        ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.eval x j ≤
          ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.certValue
            (if sample = 0 then ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.certHi0Z
            else ProofLens.Examples.TorchLeanDigits.certHi7Z)
            j
